Subject: Renewal + pricing request for annotation support

Hi Lisa,

Hope you're well. Our current annotation engagement with AnnotateNow (pilot for prompt-eval and labeling) is coming up for renewal at the end of June. We'd like to move from pilot to a steady-state engagement covering: prompt evaluation labeling (structured outputs), pairwise preference labeling for model comparisons, and an ongoing fast-turnaround QA bucket for production regressions.

Can you send an updated SOW and pricing matrix for a 12-month term + a 30-day trial month option? Key things we need covered in the SOW:
- Data handling & retention (we prefer 30 day ephemeral storage for raw user data unless redaction required)
- PII handling and redaction workflow
- QA acceptance criteria (target >=98% adjudicated agreement for pairwise tasks)
- SLA / typical turnaround for production tickets (target 48 hours for urgent triage; 5 business days for standard batches)
- Pricing tiers by annotation type (structured labels, pairwise, adjudication), and optional volume discounts starting at 100k labels/month

Marissa, Rachel — can you confirm any additional internal requirements I should pass to AnnotateNow? Priyom, tagging you for procurement/legal redline expectations.

If we can get a draft SOW and pricing by next Tuesday (2026-06-08) we can review and route to Legal. Thanks — would like to keep momentum so LLM eval work isn't disrupted.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

We're available to support the scope you described and will draft an updated SOW and a pricing matrix that includes a 30-day trial month and a 12-month renewal option with volume breakpoints. A couple quick clarifying questions before we draft:

Thanks Lisa — appreciate the quick turnaround on the pricing matrix. A few product/ops notes from our side to make the SOW actionable:

- Data handling: Redwood will deliver datasets with sensitive fields flagged. We require:
  * Triage pipeline where flagged PII is auto-redacted before human labeling unless the task explicitly requires human review.
  * Delete raw user inputs 30 days after label completion unless flagged for audit.
- QA: We need a documented adjudication workflow (two labelers + tie-breaker) and a monthly QA report with error breakdown by label type. Target pass rate >=98% for pairwise and structured labels.
- Turnaround: For production batches (non-urgent) we plan weekly pushes; for the urgent bucket, reserve a 10% capacity pool to support 48 hour turnaround during business days.
- On tooling: we require integration with our internal task API (POST /tasks/batch + callback URL). AnnotateNow should support basic retry semantics and a tracing header in callbacks.
- Pricing ask: include a line for 'adjudication per completed unit' and for 'rapid review (same-day) surcharge' — helps legal map to budget lines.

If AnnotateNow can reflect these as explicit clauses in the SOW and show the mapping to pricing lines, Legal can move faster.

Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Model Evaluation | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Inline: quoted pricing_matrix_AnnotateNow.xlsx]
